description:
The human intelligence layer for AI.

OriginalVoices gives ChatGPT instant access to real human perspectives - so you can ground decisions and AI outputs in what your target audience actually thinks, feels, and values.

Instead of guessing or relying on assumptions, get authentic feedback from real people directly inside ChatGPT. Share ideas, test messaging, validate concepts, or explore what matters to any audience - and use those insights to understand your audience, inform better decisions and create more targeted AI outputs.

With OriginalVoices, you can:
- Define any target audience
- Share anything - questions, links, copy, product concepts, campaign ideas
- Get instant responses from our network of tens of thousands of Digital Twins - AI representations of real people, each owned, trained, and validated by the person they represent

What you can use OriginalVoices for
- OriginalVoices brings real human intelligence into ChatGPT - turning every conversation into an opportunity to understand and act on authentic audience perspectives.
- Test messaging, copy, or creative concepts with your target audience
- Understand what people care about and why it matters to them
- Get feedback on landing pages, product ideas, or campaign strategies
- Create content and ads that resonates with specific audiences
- Compare perspectives across different demographics or segments
- Conduct qualitative research without the wait

How it works
- Tag OriginalVoices in ChatGPT
- Describe your target audience (e.g., "parents of toddlers in the UK," "Gen Z interested in sustainability," "small business owners")
- Share what you want feedback on - a question, a URL, an idea, copy you've written - anything
- OriginalVoices identifies relevant Digital Twins and gathers their responses. Individual perspectives are returned directly in ChatGPT, giving you real human context to inform decisions and shape outputs.
- Get started with the OriginalVoices ChatGPT App today - and bring real human insight into your AI workflows.

defaultPrompt: what do people think about my app?
what are young women's core issues with dating apps?
